description: The documented requirements of a self-hosted app or game server (n8n, Nextcloud AIO, Immich, Minecraft Java, Odoo, GitLab, ... 192 apps) and the cheapest plans that meet them.

app.description: App name or slug, e.g. n8n, immich, minecraft-java, gitlab.

location.description: Country, city or region slug, e.g. usa, germany, india, frankfurt, new-york, europe, asia, austria, vienna, helsinki, zurich.

term.description: How many months the buyer pays for at a time: 1 (the default), 12 or 24. At 12 or 24 each plan is at its cheapest price for that many months or fewer, and the row says what is paid up front (`paid`, `upFront`). A plan with no price at that length is left out.

cite.description: Cite this first: the StackRates page that shows the answer (url) and the day its prices were read (readOn), then the provider page (sourceUrl).

kind.description: Absent for a plain VPS; a dedicated server, or a Windows license in the price.

marked.description: Listed after the others and never the answer: price not confirmed for the place asked, or a Windows license not asked for.

marks.description: The row’s labels as the place pages print them ("Windows license included", "price from its price page; not confirmed for Singapore").

paid.description: How the price is paid at once, in the site’s words ("you pay 24 months up front, $126.72", "a 12-month contract, paid monthly"); absent when it is paid 1 month at a time.

unconfirmedFor.description: The place the row’s price is not confirmed for.

upFront.description: The amount paid up front ("$126.72"); absent when the price is paid 1 month at a time.
